site.name: SixSheet
site.tagline: The spoiler-free GTA VI cheat sheet

launch.note: Counting down to midnight ET, the US store listing time. Rockstar Support confirms a midnight-local launch on Nov 19 in every region on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, starting in New Zealand. In the US, the store timestamp means Central, Mountain and Pacific players may unlock before their own midnight.

facts.label: Unlock time
facts.value: Rockstar Support confirms midnight local time on Nov 19 in every region, on both PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. New Zealand goes first; US store listings show midnight Eastern (05:00 UTC).

facts.label: Platforms
facts.value: PS5, Xbox Series X and Series S. No PC version announced.

facts.label: Xbox Cloud Gaming
facts.value: Playable day one via Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox One and Series consoles, starting at 1 a.m. ET on November 19. Streams at Series S settings; the game is sold separately.

facts.label: Performance
facts.value: Rockstar says the game targets 30 fps on every console. PS5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling for a sharper image plus ray-traced shadows that only the Pro gets. Remote Play works on both PlayStation and Xbox.

facts.label: Price
facts.value: Standard $79.99 / Ultimate $99.99 (Ultimate Upgrade $20 on the US Xbox Store)

facts.label: Physical copies
facts.value: Code in a box. No disc at launch. Rockstar says boxed copies are available starting November 12 so you can redeem and pre-load. There is no physical Ultimate Edition.

facts.label: Download size
facts.value: Up to 212 GB, depending on console

facts.label: Pre-load
facts.value: Digital pre-load started November 10: midnight local time on PS5, and 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox. Redeem a code-in-box copy as soon as you have it (retail availability from November 12).

facts.label: First update
facts.value: Version 1.002 started rolling out in stages on November 13, about 1 GB on PS5. Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes. Let it install before launch night.

facts.label: Second update
facts.value: Version 1.002.001 began rolling out November 16: about 600 MB on PS5 and about 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X|S. PS5 gets it in stages, so check again if it hasn't shown up yet. Rockstar hasn't posted patch notes.

facts.label: Early-purchase bonus
facts.value: Vintage Vice City Pack: a '55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage, outfits and hairstyles, and an exclusive weapon pattern. Included with purchases before Nov 20. Digital editions also include one month of GTA+.

facts.label: Free map and poster
facts.value: From Nov 19, Rockstar's official GTA VI site will offer a free printable cover-art poster and Leonida map. A double-sided printed version follows on the Rockstar Store shortly after launch for $0.99, or free with any store order.

prep.detail: Xbox Series S 512 GB owners: expect to delete a couple of big games.
Digital pre-load has been open since November 10. Done when the game tile shows a countdown instead of a Play button. If you have a code-in-box copy, redeem it as soon as it arrives.

prep.text: Buy before Nov 20 for the Vintage Vice City Pack
prep.detail: Both editions include it. Digital copies also include one month of GTA+; claim it on the GTA+ page, and cancel if you do not want it to continue as a paid plan.

prep.text: Check your account region's unlock time
prep.detail: Your platform account region sets the unlock. Changing the console clock does nothing.

prep.text: Mute spoiler words on X, Reddit and YouTube
prep.detail: Earlier time zones unlock up to 19 hours before the Americas. Streams of the opening will be everywhere.

prep.text: Leave the console on and updated on launch night
prep.detail: Two updates have rolled out so far: 1.002 from November 13 and 1.002.001 from November 16, and more may follow. Leave the console on, or in Rest or Sleep mode with auto-updates on, and check for updates again on November 18.

gear.name: PS5 M.2 SSD (1 TB or more, with heatsink)
gear.why: 212 GB eats a third of a launch PS5.

gear.name: Xbox Series X|S storage expansion card
gear.why: The only plug-in option for running Series games.
